subject: eDiscovery hold: retention mapping + CAIQ/SIG evidence
messages:
From: Mark Liu <mark.liu@novushealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@novushealth.com
Date: 2026-05-11T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Retention hold and evidence for eDiscovery

Hi Vanessa,

We're preparing for a short-term eDiscovery hold tied to an internal investigation and need to confirm a few things from Redwood before we proceed:

- Can you provide the CAIQ export and SIG questionnaire artifacts that speak to log retention and targeted deletion workflows?
- We need an account-level retention mapping for Novus tenant IDs (session traces, request logs, inference traces) and whether any debug snapshots live outside the standard 30d TTL.
- For legal, a short sample demonstrating KMS rotation metadata and proof-of-delete timeline is helpful.

Do you have a template or a consolidated package you can share? Our legal team would like artifacts by EOD Thurs so we can finalize the hold.

Thanks,
Mark Liu
Director, Infrastructure Security
Novus Health
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Mark Liu <mark.liu@novushealth.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-11T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Retention hold and evidence for eDiscovery

Mark — thanks for flagging this. Looping in Kimberly (InfoSec) and Ben (Customer Success) to coordinate evidence delivery.

Quick answers up front:
- We can produce a CAIQ export and SIG attestations that include our retention controls; I will attach the CAIQ PDF and a retention matrix draft.
- We keep session and inference traces at the tenant level; default TTL is 30 days for session-level debug traces and 90 days for aggregated telemetry unless otherwise contracted.
- KMS rotation metadata and a proof-of-delete manifest are deliverable; we typically provide a redacted rotation log snippet and a signed confirmation when deletion workflows run.

Kimberly — can you confirm whether Novus's tenant has any bespoke retention exceptions on file? Ben — can you coordinate the retention matrix (customer column) and share the draft back so we can send a consolidated packet to Mark and legal.

I'll draft the cover note to legal once we have the artifacts.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-11T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Retention hold and evidence for eDiscovery

Vanessa / team — I pulled Novus Health's profile from the retention ledger. Notes:

- Novus (tenant_id: novus-4391) does not have an open retention exception; they are on the standard 30d session TTL with 90d aggregated telemetry.
- There is a one-off canary for debug snapshots from a 2025 incident that is flagged for auto-expiry (expires 2026-07-01) — not customer-facing but needs to be disclosed for forensics scope.
- KMS rotations are recorded in our audit service; I can extract a rotation metadata snippet (UUIDs, timestamp, key_version) but must redact full key material.

Attachments I will prepare:
- redwood_caiq_export_20260511.pdf — includes retention control mapping and references to CAIQ sections.
- kms-rotation-log-snippet.txt — redacted metadata for the latest rotation.

Priyom — can you produce the retention_matrix_novus_20260513.xlsx with tenant-level rows (session, request, inference, debug_snapshot) and explicit TTL/exception columns? Include a notes column for the canary snapshot.

I recommend the cover note state: "No customer-scoped logs are retained beyond contracted TTLs except for documented forensics canaries with explicit expiry; key materials are managed by KMS and rotation artifacts are available as metadata only."

-Kimberly
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Mark Liu <mark.liu@novushealth.com>
Cc: legal@novushealth.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-13T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Retention hold and evidence for eDiscovery — consolidated packet

Mark — attaching the consolidated packet for your legal review. Summary of what's included:

- redwood_caiq_export_20260511.pdf (attached) — CAIQ export with retention-related control mappings and evidence references.
- retention_matrix_novus_20260513.xlsx (attached) — tenant-level retention mapping, TTLs, and canary note for the debug snapshot.
- kms-rotation-log-snippet.txt (attached) — redacted rotation metadata showing last two rotation events (timestamps + IDs).

Short answers to your original questions:
- Evidence: CAIQ and CAIQ-linked SIG references included in the PDF.
- Tenant mapping: See the retention matrix; session traces = 30d, inference token traces = 30d by default, aggregated telemetry = 90d. Canary debug snapshot currently scheduled to expire 2026-07-01.
- Proof-of-delete: For any requested delete we provide a signed deletion manifest and a pointer to the job run id in our audit system; we cannot disclose full storage keys but provide job-level confirmation and checksums.

If legal wants a timeboxed affidavit or a sample deletion manifest for the canary, we can prepare one. Next step: do you want us to push the canary snapshot to immediate deletion or preserve it until 2026-07-01 for your internal review?

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_caiq_export_20260511.pdf (PDF), retention_matrix_novus_20260513.xlsx (Excel), kms-rotation-log-snippet.txt (text)
From: Mark Liu <mark.liu@novushealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@novushealth.com
Date: 2026-05-13T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Retention hold and evidence for eDiscovery — consolidated packet

Vanessa / Kimberly — received, thank you for the fast turnaround and helpful summary. Legal reviewed the CAIQ and the retention matrix — a couple quick asks:

1) Could you provide a sample signed deletion manifest for the canary snapshot (redact storage IDs but include job run id and checksum)?
2) We'll request that the canary be preserved until EOD 2026-06-01 to allow for a short internal review. Please confirm you can hold the snapshot until then and not auto-delete on 2026-07-01.

If you can share the sample manifest and confirm the preservation window, we can close out the hold language on our side.

Thanks,
Mark
Director, Infrastructure Security
Novus Health
